class: Comma-separated skills treated as one searchable selection
symptom: The experience page searched the entire skills list and exposed an empty Options Expanded popup, delaying progression.
root_cause: Textbox-shaped prompts used the single-selection path for a multi-value skills answer. No offered skill could equal the combined list.
fix: Search skills individually within the associated widget popup, verify selected tags, preserve existing tags, and leave unsupported optional skills blank with a note and closed menu.
